text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. Breaking a project into milestones helps teams track progress and stay motivated along the way. Deliverables should be clearly defined so everyone knows what needs to be completed and when. It is also important to ensure stakeholder alignment, meaning everyone involved agrees on the project's purpose and expected results. When goals are well planned and all parties share the same understanding, projects are more likely to finish on time and meet expectations.
